note: This file is a pure configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines dataset settings, preprocessing pipelines, and dataloader configurations for ImageNet training with Mixer models (bs=64, 224x224). No CLI-invocable code is present.
config_dataset_type: configure the ImageNet dataset type for pretraining with 1000 classes
config_data_preprocessor: configure image normalization with mean and std of 127.5 for RGB input
config_train_pipeline: configure the training augmentation pipeline with random crop, flip, and pack inputs
config_test_pipeline: configure the test pipeline with bicubic resize, center crop, and pack inputs
config_train_dataloader: configure the training dataloader with batch size 64 and 5 workers for ImageNet
